description: This Java class defines mapping strategies for various thing query commands within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It maps different signal types to JSON serializable command objects, facilitates retrieval of specific data related to 'things', and implements singleton pattern with auxiliary methods for extracting data from adaptables.

classes.name: ThingQueryCommandMappingStrategies
classes.description: A singleton class that maps string identifiers of thing query commands to their corresponding JSONifiableMapper implementations, providing a central mechanism to serialize various query commands for the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ThingQueryCommandMappingStrategies.

methods.name: initMappingStrategies
methods.description: Initializes and returns a map of command type strings to their corresponding JsonifiableMapper instances, used for serializing different thing query commands.

methods.name: thingsIdsFrom
methods.description: Extracts a list of ThingId objects from the payload within an Adaptable instance, parsing a JsonArray of IDs.
